change: Classify supported media feature names by byte length, then query the live document using MediaFeatureID. Hover preserves the original early branch. No cached names or values; the existing complete string-chain implementation remains the control.

component.qualification: Current-process unprofiled instruction intervals; setup/oracle creation and warmup are excluded. Every counted parsed-query result is checked and included in the checksum. These are query-evaluation intervals rather than isolated classification costs. Allocation, batched scratch lifetime and checking are included. Diagnostic runs are separate. Component savings earn no whole-page credit.

initial.qualification: The initial classifier saved 29-36% on the main query groups but regressed 2.979% on early-name queries. Preserving the original hover branch reduces the final early-name regression to 1.818%. Both component cohorts and all prior checks remain retained.

qualification: Twelve final focused jobs pass: four compile jobs and both lookup modes under poisoned preallocation, ordinary GC, no GC and ASan/UBSan, for 344 test-function executions. All 37 names, arbitrary/case-sensitive names, fractional/zero viewports, current density/preferences, direct expression edits and caller-storage retirement are covered. Components are synthetic parsed-query evaluations with exact boolean/checksum checks, not isolated classifier or page costs. Early-name regression is retained. No whole-page, live-site, Brave or scrolling credit.
